program:
:- prefix(ex, 'https://example.org/1428/').
ex:holds(X, ex:yes) :- X is 1, A is 2/3, B is 1, A >= B.
?- ex:holds(X, Y).

provenance.derivation: 2/3 >= 1 ? 2/3 ~= 0.667 < 1, so 2/3 >= 1 is FALSE. Cross-multiply: 2*1=2 vs 3*1=3; 2 < 3, confirming 2/3 < 1, so the `>=` filter prunes the only candidate solution and `ex:holds(X, ex:yes)` never fires -- the goal `ex:holds(X, Y)` has zero answers. `X` is an unused dummy arg (`X is 1`) so the goal atom is arity >= 2, keeping the query on the binary backward path -- see the corpus README's arity note.
provenance.note: independently derived; never hand-edited to match the native engine
